say:3:1211403002:1.text: Sinbad! How did you get here?

say:4:1211403003:0.text: I can't use magic, so I swam over!
say:4:1211403003:0.source_cn: 我又不会魔法，当然是游过来的！

say:5:1211403004:0.text: You fool! That was such a risky move.

say:7:1211403005:0.text: Would you rather I watched from afar while you fought? There's no way I'd do that.
say:7:1211403005:0.source_cn: 难道要我远远看着你们拼命？我可做不到。

say:8:1211403006:1.text: You should be providing backup, not—
say:8:1211403006:1.source_cn: 你应该为我们提供后援！而不是——

say:9:1211403007:1.text: Relax, Sonja. I've steered the Chainkeeper to a safe distance, and Hugin's helping at the helm.
say:9:1211403007:1.source_cn: 行了行了。我把枷锁号驶到了相对安全的距离，呼金老兄在帮...

say:10:1211403008:1.text: If you have time to nag me, use that time instead to pray he doesn't sink the ship.
say:10:1211403008:1.source_cn: 你要是有空啰嗦，还不如祈祷他别把船开沉了呢。

say:11:1211403009:1.text: ... I just hope we'll all get out safe.

say:12:1211403010:1.text: There's no need to be so pessimistic! We're so close to the end now, we've got this.
say:12:1211403010:1.source_cn: 都到这一步了，哪有什么退路？没看出来你也有天真的一面啊。

say:13:1211403011:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why don't you comfort her? She seems really tense for some reason.
say:13:1211403011:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why don't you comfort her? She seems really tense for some reason.
say:13:1211403011:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why don't you comfort her? She seems really tense for some reason.

choice_prompt:14:1211403011.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why don't you comfort her? She seems really tense for some reason.
choice_prompt:14:1211403011.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，要不你安慰安慰她？我看她好像很紧张。
choice_prompt:14:1211403011.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why don't you comfort her? She seems really tense for some reason.
choice_prompt:14:1211403011.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why don't you comfort her? She seems really tense for some reason.

say:15:1211403012:1.text: Thank you for the compliment, but...
say:15:1211403012:1.male: Thank you for the compliment, but...
say:15:1211403012:1.female: Thank you for the compliment, but...

say:16:1211403015:1.text: Oh... Stop overthinking it, alright? We'll definitely take down Hodgkin!
say:16:1211403015:1.source_cn: 哎哟……别想太多了行不行？我们一定打能败霍德希金！

say:17:1211403016:1.text: The deck is broken. Instead of dawdling here, let's find another way across.
say:17:1211403016:1.source_cn: 甲板已经断了，与其在这里磨磨蹭蹭，还是快找找有没有其他...

say:19:1211403013:1.text: She... probably doesn't need my concern.
say:19:1211403013:1.source_cn: 她大概……不需要我的关心。
say:19:1211403013:1.male: She... probably doesn't need my concern.
say:19:1211403013:1.female: She... probably doesn't need my concern.

say:20:1211403014:1.text: At this point, I don't want anyone else to die in vain. There have been enough sacrifices.
say:20:1211403014:1.source_cn: 事到如今，我不希望大家白白送死。牺牲的人已经够多了。
say:20:1211403014:1.male: At this point, I don't want anyone else to die in vain. There have been enough sacrifices.
say:20:1211403014:1.female: At this point, I don't want anyone else to die in vain. There have been enough sacrifices.

choice:14:2:3.text: Sonja cares about all of us.
choice:14:2:3.male: Sonja cares about all of us.
choice:14:2:3.female: Sonja cares about all of us.
